The thieves' guild keeps its own roads.
Every road in the Bifrost hides a wall that isn't a wall.
Behind each one, a sanctuary known only to thieves.
Cicada, the spy network of the Paladins of Parabellum, has spent years trying to get inside.
Only one infiltration has ever been reported.
Agent Kat's report describes something odd.
Captured thieves insist it's just extra security.
If only thieves know the way in...
